resources.description: Argentina official gazette (Boletin Oficial) keyword search returning literal excerpts of matching notices with dates and source URLs; an optional date limits the search to that day's notices. Use this when an agent needs primary-source evidence of an Argentine regulation, decree, resolution or notice. No completeness guarantee and no legal interpretation; if the official search cannot be verified the call fails and is not settled. Free sample at /api/normativa-ar/sample.

example.error: Si la consulta oficial no puede verificarse, el servicio devuelve un error; no se interpreta como ausencia de resultados.

date.description: Opcional: fecha de publicación YYYY-MM-DD para activar el modo diario; debe ser una fecha real. Omitir para buscar por palabra clave sin fecha.

limit.description: Máximo de avisos a leer; predeterminado: 3

query.description: Palabra clave o texto de búsqueda no vacío

resources.description: Validate an Argentine CUIT or CUIL tax id: format and check-digit verification, normalized and formatted forms, declared type (CUIT or CUIL). Use this when an agent collects Argentine customer or supplier ids and must reject typos before invoicing, KYC or onboarding. Mathematical validation only: it does not confirm registration or ownership. JSON, no model inference. Free sample at /api/cuit-ar/sample.

example.scope: La comprobación de formato y dígito no acredita asignación, titularidad, inscripción ni vigencia. CUIT y CUIL comparten formato y algoritmo; el tipo declarado no está confirmado.

type.description: Tipo declarado; auto deja el tipo sin determinar.

resources.description: Translate or adapt text of up to 6,000 characters into natural Spanish as spoken in Argentina and the Rio de la Plata (voseo), keeping names, numbers, links and formatting. Use this when an agent needs Spanish copy for Argentine or Uruguayan users, such as support replies, product listings, notifications or marketing, instead of neutral or European Spanish. Optional tone: formal, neutral or casual. Any input language; JSON output. Free sample at /api/translate-es/sample.

text.description: Text to translate into Rioplatense Spanish

tone.description: Tone of the translation: formal, neutral (default) or casual

resources.description: x402 adoption and Bazaar stats with sources: seller and host concentration, how many listings have real unique payers in 30 days, USDC price percentiles, keyword categories, the paid demand radar, from a full crawl of the Coinbase x402 Bazaar. Use this when an agent or builder needs current x402 market numbers with source URLs before deciding what to sell or buy. Sections: overview, sellers, payers, prices, demand, all. No model inference. Free sample at /api/x402-adoption/sample.

conclusions: Illustrative documentation example, not live data.
example.scope: Counts over fetched data; not an estimate.

section.description: Which part of the report to return. overview: headline counts and conclusions; bazaar: network, asset and version shares; sellers: host and wallet concentration plus the Agent402 leaderboard; payers: how many resources have 1, 2, 5 or 10+ unique payers in 30 days; prices: USDC price percentiles; categories: keyword categories; demand: the paid demand radar; all: everything.

resources.description: x402 payment test and ping: one call with no required parameters returns server time (ISO 8601 and Unix ms), a request id, the seller payTo, chain id and an echo of your optional text, only after a real settlement. Use this when an agent needs to prove its payment flow works, measure round-trip latency or run a cheap scheduled canary against a live seller. No upstream, no model inference; paid round trip 1 to 2 s. Free sample at /api/x402-ping/sample.

example.policy: settled only after a successful response; paid round trip 1 to 2 s (verify and settle first)

echo.description: Optional text echoed back (up to 200 characters).

resources.description: Hash sha256, sha512, sha1 or md5, HMAC, JWT decode (header, payload, expiry, optional HS256 check), UUID v4, base64 encode and decode, URL parse, time zone convert and unix to ISO: one deterministic op per call. Use this when an agent needs a verifiable transform without shipping its own library. Pure Node, no upstream, no model inference, nothing stored, JSON out. Free sample at /api/dev-utils/sample.

algorithm.description: Hash algorithm for hash and hmac (default sha256).

from.description: IANA source time zone for tz_convert (default UTC).

secret.description: Secret for hmac or for optional HS256 verification in jwt_decode.

to.description: IANA target time zone for tz_convert (default UTC).

value.description: Input text, token, URL, timestamp or local datetime (depends on op).

resources.description: Summarize text with evidence: send 1 to 4,000 characters in English or Spanish and get a short summary plus 1 to 3 supporting quotes verified as exact substrings of your text, with a limitations note. Use this when an agent must condense an article, email or document and needs citations it can check before putting them in a report. Works only on the supplied text, no web retrieval, JSON out. Free sample at /api/source-bounded-summary/sample.

body.text: Ana entregó el informe el lunes. Luis lo revisó el martes.

evidence.quote: Ana entregó el informe el lunes.

example.limitations: Citas comprobadas como fragmentos literales del texto proporcionado; no se verificaron hechos ni fuentes externas. El resumen generado puede contener errores de interpretación.
example.summary: Ana entregó el informe el lunes y Luis lo revisó el martes.

text.description: Source text; no secrets or sensitive data

resources.description: FX rates and currency conversion reference: daily exchange rates for up to 20 currencies against one base (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, BRL, MXN, ARS and about 160 more) with rate, reference date and source URL from Frankfurter (central-bank data, MIT licence). Use this when an agent needs an official-style exchange rate to price, invoice or convert amounts and must cite where it came from. Daily rates, not intraday; JSON, no model inference. Free sample at /api/fx-rates/sample.

example.scope: Daily reference rates, not intraday quotes; each rate carries its own reference date.

quotes.description: Comma-separated quote currencies, 1 to 20 ISO 4217 codes.

resources.description: Polymarket markets and prediction market odds: one page of public markets from the Gamma API (text and status filters, order by volume or liquidity, outcome prices) or a wallet's positions and activity from the Data API, with source URL and read time. Use this when an agent needs prediction-market odds, event lists or a trader's positions as evidence for a forecast or a report. JSON, no model inference. Free sample at /api/polymarket-markets/sample.

example.scope: Text and status filters and ordering apply only to this source page. Results do not establish global matches or global ranking; an empty selection does not establish absence of matching markets.

limit.description: Upstream page size before local filtering; defaults to 5. A filtered page may return fewer records or none.

offset.description: Offset passed to the upstream endpoint before local filtering; defaults to 0. Endpoint-specific restrictions may cause an upstream error.

order.description: Descending ordering within the received market page; missing numeric values sort last. Defaults to volume. Markets only.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring search in question and slug within the received market page. Whitespace-only values are rejected. Markets only.

resource.description: Defaults to markets. Positions and activity require user.

status.description: Filter the received market page. Active requires active=true and closed=false; closed requires closed=true. Defaults to all. Markets only.

user.description: Public wallet address required for positions and activity; rejected for markets.

resources.description: Crypto price in USD for bitcoin, ethereum, solana and up to 20 coins per call by CoinGecko id: spot price, market cap, 24h change, provider update time and source URL. Use this when an agent needs a current BTC, ETH or token price before a quote, a conversion, a report or an alert, with a citation it can re-check. Live from CoinGecko's public API, no key, JSON, no model inference. Free sample at /api/crypto-prices/sample.

example.scope: Illustrative fixture with simulated values and timestamp; not a live market reading.

coins.description: Comma-separated list of 1–20 distinct lowercase CoinGecko IDs, such as bitcoin,ethereum. Symbols are not supported.

resources.description: Read URL content: extract the readable plain text and title of any public web page, with scripts, styles and navigation removed, plus character count, truncation flags and read time. Use this when an agent needs the text of an article, doc or product page to quote, classify or summarize, without an API key. Static HTML only (no JavaScript, no login), up to 20,000 characters, JSON out. For Markdown output use /api/web-read. Free sample at /api/url-text/sample.

example.scope: Simulated documentation example, not a live reading.
example.title: Illustrative page

format.description: Output format: plain text or simple Markdown. Defaults to text.

maxChars.description: Maximum returned text length in UTF-16 code units, from 1000 to 20000. Defaults to 10000.

url.description: Public HTTPS page URL. Private addresses and pages requiring authentication are unsupported.

resources.description: Web page to Markdown or plain text: fetch one public URL and get its title and main content with scripts, styles, navigation and ads stripped, plus character count and truncation flags. Use this when an agent needs to read a URL for research, RAG, monitoring or summarization without an API key or a browser. One HTTPS fetch of static HTML (no JavaScript rendering, no login pages), up to 20,000 characters, JSON out. Free sample at /api/web-read/sample.

example.scope: Best-effort extraction from one received HTML response using structural heuristics. No JavaScript execution or authenticated access. CSS and generic navigation may not be recognized. Common HTML entities are decoded; other named entities are retained. Source completeness is unknown because the reader supplied no usable truncation flag. Extracted content fits within maxChars. Title is extracted from the received title element and limited to 1000 UTF-16 units. The storefront reader limits received raw HTML to 20,000 UTF-16 code units before extraction; this limit includes markup and omitted content.
example.text: This domain is for use in documentation examples without needing permission. This is not a service; avoid relying on it for testing and monitoring purposes.
example.title: Example Domain

format.description: Output format: plain text or simple Markdown. Defaults to text.

maxChars.description: Maximum returned text length in UTF-16 code units, from 1000 to 20000. Defaults to 10000.

url.description: Public HTTPS page URL. Private addresses and pages requiring authentication are unsupported.

resources.description: Argentine peso dollar rates in one GET with no parameters: oficial, blue, MEP, CCL, tarjeta and cripto with buy and sell quotes from DolarApi (open source, MIT), plus the gap percent between the crypto dollar and the official rate, source URL, read time and provider update time. Use this when an agent prices, converts or reports anything in Argentina and needs the real dollar, not only the official one. JSON, no model inference. Free sample at /api/dolar-ar/sample.

example.scope: Cotizaciones publicadas por DolarAPI. La hora de lectura y la fecha de actualización de cada registro son distintas; no garantiza precios en tiempo real ni confirma datos con otra fuente.

resources.description: Compare two strings literally, with no normalization and no inference: equality, lengths, and the first difference with line, column, Unicode code point and UTF-16 offset. Up to 20,000 UTF-16 units each. Use this when an agent must check that a delivered text matches the agreed text exactly, or locate where two versions diverge. Deterministic JSON. Free sample at /api/comparar-textos/sample.

example.scope: Compara literalmente las cadenas recibidas, sin normalización ni inferencia. No verifica bytes de archivos, hechos ni aceptación de una entrega.

entrega.description: Delivered text; handler limit: 20000 UTF-16 units

original.description: Original text; handler limit: 20000 UTF-16 units

resources.description: Argentine street address lookup: candidate matches from the official Georef API (street, number, locality, department, province, coordinates) with the source record, URL and read time; optional province id narrows the search. Use this when an agent must normalize or geocode an address in Argentina before shipping, invoicing or mapping. No uniqueness guarantee; JSON, no model inference. Free sample at /api/direcciones-ar/sample.

direcciones.nomenclatura: AV CORRIENTES 1234, Comuna 1, Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires

direccion.description: Address text, from 3 to 200 characters. Locality text alone may not restrict results.

limit.description: Maximum returned candidates, from 1 to 10; defaults to 5.

provinciaId.description: Optional two-digit province identifier, preserving leading zeros. Example: 02 for CABA.

resources.description: Argentina central bank (BCRA) statistics: one page of monetary variables or dated observations of a series (interest rates, reserves, exchange rate, inflation indicators) from BCRA's public API v4.0, with source URL and read time. Use this when an agent needs official Argentine macro data with provenance. JSON, no model inference. Free sample at /api/bcra-indicadores/sample.

example.scope: Illustrative fixture with simulated values, pagination and timestamp; not a live BCRA reading.
example.source: Banco Central de la República Argentina, public statistics API v4.0

desde.description: Optional serie-only start date, YYYY-MM-DD; must not exceed hasta.

idVariable.description: Required for serie; forbidden for lista. Positive BCRA variable ID.

query.description: Optional lista-only text filter within the received page; matches ID, description and category without case or accent distinctions.

resource.description: lista returns variables; serie returns observations for one variable.

resources.description: Formal letter in Argentine Spanish drafted from the facts you supply: claim, demand or request to a company or person, with sender, recipient, subject, facts, what you ask for and an optional response deadline in days. Use this when an agent must produce a firm, courteous letter for an Argentine consumer or business dispute. Returns the letter as text; it does not verify facts or give legal advice. Free sample at /api/cartas-ar/sample.

body.hechos: El 8 de octubre de 2026 consulté por la entrega y no recibí respuesta. El 2 de octubre de 2026 compré una mesa por $85.000. La entrega acordada era el 7 de octubre de 2026 y ese día no recibí la mesa.
body.solicitud: Solicito que informen una fecha concreta de entrega de la mesa.

example.alcance: Borrador redactado con un modelo a partir de los datos suministrados. No verifica hechos ni determina derechos, plazos legales o efectos jurídicos. Revisá el texto antes de usarlo.
example.carta:
Rosario, 13 de octubre de 2026

Comercio Los Aromos

Referencia: Reclamo por entrega pendiente

Me dirijo a ustedes para presentar un reclamo por la entrega pendiente de una mesa.

El 2 de octubre de 2026 compré una mesa por $85.000. La entrega acordada era el 7 de octubre de 2026 y ese día no recibí la mesa. El 8 de octubre de 2026 consulté por la entrega y no recibí respuesta.

Solicito que informen una fecha concreta de entrega de la mesa. Solicito una respuesta en un plazo de 5 días.

Atentamente,

Ana Pérez

asunto.description: Asunto que debe figurar en la referencia de la carta

hechos.description: Hechos aportados para redactar el cuerpo; se ordenan cronológicamente cuando los datos lo permiten

lugarYFecha.description: Lugar y fecha suministrados por el comprador

plazoDias.description: Plazo solicitado de respuesta en días. No determina un plazo legal ni una fecha de vencimiento.

remitente.description: Nombre o identificación que debe figurar en la firma

solicitud.description: Petición concreta y condiciones aportadas por el comprador

tipo.description: Tipo de carta; si se omite, se usa reclamo. No determina efectos jurídicos.
